source.guide: PowerPyx: Red Dead Redemption 2 All Animal Locations (Zoologist & Skin Deep)
source.note: points: where the guide's author found the animal (the in-game waypoint or, for legendary animals, the map cursor). zones: ellipses the author drew around the area, as polygons. Facts are parsed from the guide; description and tips are written from them, not copied.

coordinates: lat/lng of map 1 (world) in the app: XYZ Web Mercator tiles of tiles.mapgenie.io
